newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Suncorp-Metway to issue US$ FRN in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Suncorp-Metway to issue US$ FRN in Q3.

text.p: Suncorp-Metway Ltd said on Wednesday it will launch a U.S. dollar floating rate note in the third quarter as part of its Euro-medium term note programme.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell has been appointed as arranger of the programme and as lead manager to the benchmark issue.
Deutsche is also in the dealer group along with BZW, Chase Manhattan International, Merrill Lynch International, SBC Warburg and Nomura International.
"It is anticipated the Euro medium note programme will be signed and launched with the FRN issue later this year," said Caji DeSouza, Chief Financial Officer, at Suncorp-Metway. "
"The programme complements our current wholsale funding activities in the domestic and Asian markets and allows us to diversify the group's wholesale funding portfolio."
